_note: 會員章完成指南 — 官方 11 項（香港童軍訓練綱要）＋ 本旅的完成要求、考核方法與資源連結。領袖可自行修改此檔內容。另加 quest 區塊：每個關卡的遊戲名稱、提示，以及遊玩說明文字（可自行修改）。
source_zh: 香港童軍訓練綱要 · 會員章（11 項）
source_en: HKSAR Scout Training Scheme · Membership Badge (11 items)

items.title_zh: 與你的小隊長商議有關加入童軍團之安排。
items.title_en: Discuss the arrangements for joining the Scout Troop with your patrol leader.
req_zh: 加入童軍團
req_en: Join the Scout Troop
items.method_note_en: Joining is the requirement — a leader confirms it
items.stage_hint_zh: 你已在簡介會認識童軍運動 — 本關自動完成！
items.stage_hint_en: You already met the Scouts at the briefing — this stage is done for you.

items.title_zh: 加入一小隊及從小隊活動中認識隊中其他成員。
items.title_en: Join a patrol and get to know the other members through patrol activities.
req_zh: 認識小隊成員
了解小隊職位
了解小隊成員電話號碼（隊長／聯絡）
req_en: Know the members of your patrol
Know the patrol jobs
Know your patrol's phone numbers (leader / contact)
items.stage_hint_zh: 加入小隊，認識你的隊長、隊友及他們的電話。
items.stage_hint_en: Join a patrol: know your leader, your teammates and their numbers.

items.title_zh: 最少參加六次團集會／活動，其中一次應在戶外舉行。
items.title_en: Take part in at least six troop meetings or activities, one of them outdoors.
req_zh: 參加五次室內集會／活動
參加一次戶外集會／活動
req_en: Attend five indoor meetings / activities
Attend one outdoor activity
items.stage_hint_zh: 出席六次集會／活動，其中一次在戶外舉行。
items.stage_hint_en: Six meetings or activities, one of them outdoors.

items.title_zh: 對世界及香港童軍運動之發展有普遍的認識。
items.title_en: Have a general knowledge of the development of the Scout Movement worldwide and in Hong Kong.
req_zh: 在第一個區域完成「童軍歷史山洞」遊戲：閱讀四面壁畫，逐組完成全部 50 題。走到洞口即自動通關，不設合格分數；成績只供回顧。
完成山洞遊戲便完成第 4 項，不需要另外作答試卷。
req_en: In area one, clear The Cave of Scouting History: read four wall paintings and finish all 50 questions in groups. Reaching the exit automatically clears the game, whatever your score; the score is for review.
Clearing the cave completes item 4. There is no separate paper to sit.
items.method_note_zh: 完成山洞後自動記錄通關及成績
items.method_note_en: The cave records completion and score automatically
items.stage_hint_zh: 看完四段壁畫，在石室完成全部 50 題即通關；分數只供回顧，無須另做試卷。
items.stage_hint_en: Read four wall paintings and finish all 50 chamber questions to clear the game; the score is for review. No separate paper.

items.title_zh: 明瞭及接納童軍誓詞、規律和銘言。
items.title_en: Understand and accept the Scout Promise, Law and Motto.
req_zh: 背誦童軍誓詞、規律和銘言
了解並解釋童軍規律
req_en: Recite the Scout Promise, Law and Motto
Understand and explain the Scout Law
items.stage_hint_zh: 背熟誓詞、規律、銘言，並要解釋規律。
items.stage_hint_en: Learn the Promise, Law and Motto by heart — and explain the Law.

items.title_zh: 認識你在宣誓時應有之童軍禮儀，以及中式隊列之基本動作。
items.title_en: Know the Scout customs for the investiture ceremony and the basic movements of Chinese-style drill.
req_zh: 步操：salute
alert / stand-at-ease
right turn / left turn / about turn
pace forward / backward / left / right march
dressing — right dress
mark time
by the front quick march
req_en: Drill: salute
alert / stand-at-ease
right turn / left turn / about turn
pace forward / backward / left / right march
dressing — right dress
mark time
by the front quick march
items.stage_hint_zh: 敬禮、轉身、步操 — 考核你的中式隊列。
items.stage_hint_en: Salute, turns and marching — the Chinese drill movements.

items.title_zh: 能辨認中華人民共和國國旗和國徽；並能說明其含意。
items.title_en: Recognise the national flag and emblem of the People's Republic of China and explain their meaning.
req_zh: 完成「第 7 至 10 項試卷」，合格分數為 24 分／30 分
能認出國旗、國徽並說出含意
req_en: Complete the Items 7–10 paper — pass mark 24 / 30
Recognise the national flag and emblem and explain their meaning
items.method_note_zh: 自行考核 — 第 7 至 10 項共用同一份試卷

links.label_zh: 第 7 至 10 項試卷（Google Form）

items.stage_hint_zh: 認識國旗與國徽，並能說明其含意。
items.stage_hint_en: Know the national flag and emblem, and what they mean.

items.title_zh: 能辨認香港特別行政區區旗和區徽；並能說明其含意。
items.title_en: Recognise the regional flag and emblem of the Hong Kong SAR and explain their meaning.
req_zh: 由「第 7 至 10 項試卷」考核
能認出區旗、區徽並說出含意
req_en: Covered by the Items 7–10 paper
Recognise the regional flag and emblem and explain their meaning

links.label_zh: 第 7 至 10 項試卷（Google Form）

items.stage_hint_zh: 認識區旗與區徽，並能說明其含意。
items.stage_hint_en: Know the regional flag and emblem, and what they mean.

items.title_zh: 認識在國歌奏唱和升掛國旗、區旗時應有之禮儀，以及升國旗的基本程序。
items.title_en: Know the proper etiquette when the national anthem is played and the flags are raised, and the basic flag-raising procedure.
req_zh: 由「第 7 至 10 項試卷」考核
示範國歌奏唱及升旗時應有的禮儀
req_en: Covered by the Items 7–10 paper
Show the correct etiquette for the anthem and flag-raising
items.stage_hint_zh: 國歌奏唱與升旗時，你應該怎樣做？
items.stage_hint_en: What to do when the anthem plays and the flags go up.

items.title_zh: 明瞭設立國歌的用意，並能背唱之。
items.title_en: Understand the purpose of the national anthem and be able to sing it from memory.
req_zh: 由「第 7 至 10 項試卷」考核
能背唱國歌
req_en: Covered by the Items 7–10 paper
Sing the national anthem from memory
items.stage_hint_zh: 明瞭國歌的用意，並能背唱。
items.stage_hint_en: Understand the anthem and sing it from memory.

items.title_zh: 認識常見兒童侵害情況、預防方法及處理方法。
items.title_en: Know common situations of child abuse, how to prevent them and how to handle them.
req_zh: 認識常見兒童侵害情況
知道預防方法
知道遇到時如何處理及求助
req_en: Know the common situations
Know how to prevent them
Know how to respond and where to get help
items.stage_hint_zh: 認識兒童侵害、預防方法及求助方法。
items.stage_hint_en: Know the risks, how to prevent them and who to ask for help.

quest.tagline_zh: 五個區域，各有一個遊戲；五個遊戲全部完成，即可考取會員章。
quest.tagline_en: Five areas, one game each. Clear all five games and the badge is yours.
quest.start_zh: 開始歷險 · 進入遊戲 1
quest.first_stage_note_zh: 按下開始按鈕，直接進入第一區的童軍歷史山洞。
quest.first_stage_note_en: Press the start button to go straight into the cave in location 1.
quest.credited_body_zh: 你已划到叢林深處。第一個區域只有童軍歷史山洞；完成遊戲，就可以繼續尋找通往沙灘的路。
quest.credited_body_en: You have reached the jungle. The first area holds only The Cave of Scouting History. Clear it to keep going toward the beach.
quest.story_lead_zh: 童軍大露營途中，船撞上礁石。醒來的時候，你發現自己獨自流落在一個荒島上。
quest.story_lead_en: On the way to camp the boat hit the reef. You wake up alone on an island.

beats_zh.title: 在荒島醒來
beats_zh.text: 四周都是叢林，海浪聲從遠處傳來。你的口袋裡只有一個指南針，以及一張濕透的地圖。

beats_zh.title: 走過五個區域
beats_zh.text: 地圖上有一條小徑，穿過五個區域一直通到海邊。每個區域各有一個遊戲，五個遊戲全部玩過才算走完這一程。

beats_zh.title: 沙灘上的木筏
beats_zh.text: 走到沙灘，你會找到一條木筏。五個區域的遊戲全部完成，木筏便可下水，載你離開荒島，考獲會員章。

beats_en.title: You wake up ashore
beats_en.text: Jungle all around, the sea somewhere behind it. All you have is a compass and a soaked map.

beats_en.title: Five areas to cross
beats_en.text: One path runs through five areas to the shore. Each area holds its own game, and all five must be cleared before the island lets you go.

beats_en.title: The raft on the beach
beats_en.text: At the beach you find a raft. Clear the game in each of the five areas, then set sail off the island and earn the Membership Badge.

quest.trail_lead_zh: 第一區的山洞遊戲已直接標示在地圖上，毋須先點選區域。看完資料後，按頁底的按鈕直接開始遊戲。五個遊戲全部完成，才可以乘木筏離開。
quest.trail_lead_en: The cave game is shown right on location 1. No need to pick a location: read the details and use the single button below to start playing. Clear all five games to reach the raft.
quest.trail_last_note_zh: 五個區域各有一個遊戲。五個遊戲全部完成後，便可到達沙灘，乘木筏離開。
quest.trail_last_note_en: One game in each of five areas. Clear all five to reach the beach and escape on the raft.
quest.start_note_zh: 從第一區的山洞遊戲開始，完成五個遊戲便可到達沙灘。
quest.start_note_en: Start with the cave in location 1, then clear all five games to reach the beach.
quest.route_zh: 五個區域 → 沙灘 → 木筏
quest.route_en: Five areas → the beach → the raft
quest.goal_zh: 走過五個區域，到達沙灘，造好木筏
quest.goal_en: Cross all five areas, reach the beach, build the raft

areas.hint_zh: 從叢林開始探險。閱讀山洞裡的壁畫，走過石室，找出童軍歷史的線索。
areas.hint_en: Begin in the jungle. Read the cave walls and find the clues to Scouting history in the stone chambers.

game.blurb_zh: 四段壁畫、五十題。壁畫先交代那一組題目要用的資料，之後在石室逐題作答；答錯會走入死路，死路會再講一次那段歷史。
game.blurb_en: Four wall paintings and fifty questions. Each wall teaches everything its questions need, then you answer in the chamber — a wrong turn walks you into a dead end where the history is retold.

areas.hint_zh: 霧裡有一條河，水聲很響。把木板按次序鋪成橋，就可以走到對岸。
areas.hint_en: A river runs loud in the mist. Lay the planks in order to build a crossing.

game.blurb_zh: 三關：銘言（最易）→ 誓詞 → 規律。每一關先讀教學牌，再把木板按次序鋪上橋；放錯了，木板會滑到河裡，教學牌會再講一次。
game.blurb_en: Three stages: the motto (easiest) → the Promise → the Law. Read the teaching card, then lay the planks in order — a wrong board slips into the river and the card teaches it again.

areas.hint_zh: 攀上山脊：閱兵場上翻開《步操手冊》，逐個動作學會，再找領袖親身考核。
areas.hint_en: Climb to the crest: the parade ground opens the drill manual, movement by movement, then a leader assesses you in person.

game.blurb_zh: 七章手冊：基本姿勢、轉法、敬禮、移步、快步、七類集隊手號、看齊。逐個動作看手冊圖學要領，答對自查題；全部通過後找領袖親身考核，輸入領袖代碼完成遊戲 3。
game.blurb_en: Seven chapters: positions, turns, the salute, paces, quick time, the seven fall-in hand signs and the right dress. Learn each movement from the manual's own pages, answer the self-checks, then perform them for a leader and bring back the code to finish game 3.

areas.hint_zh: 溪邊豎著旗桿。國旗、區旗與升旗禮儀，都在這裡考。
areas.hint_en: A flagpole by the stream. The flags and the flag ceremony are tested here.

game.blurb_zh: 這一區的遊戲正在製作，等待領袖加入。
game.blurb_en: This area’s game is being built. Your leader will add it later.

areas.hint_zh: 海風近了。唱好國歌，學懂保護自己，沙灘就在前面。
areas.hint_en: Sea air. Sing the anthem, learn to keep yourself safe — the beach is ahead.

game.blurb_zh: 這一區的遊戲正在製作，等待領袖加入。
game.blurb_en: This area’s game is being built. Your leader will add it later.

quest.game_rule_zh: 每個區域各有一個遊戲；五個遊戲全部完成，才可以考取會員章。
quest.game_rule_en: Every area holds one game. All five must be cleared before the badge is awarded.

intro_slides.text_zh: 大露營的旅途上，風暴突然來襲，船撞上了礁石。巨浪把你沖上一個陌生的荒島。
intro_slides.text_en: On the way to camp a storm strikes and the boat runs onto the reef. The waves wash you ashore on a strange island.
intro_slides.alt_en: A boat broken on the rocks in a storm

intro_slides.text_zh: 你獨自醒來，四周都是叢林，海浪聲從遠處傳來。口袋裏只剩一個指南針，和一張濕透的地圖。
intro_slides.text_en: You wake up alone. Jungle all around, the sea somewhere behind it. All you have is a compass and a soaked map.

intro_slides.text_zh: 地圖上的虛線穿過五個地點，一直通到海邊的木筏。每個地點各有一個遊戲要完成——五個全部玩過，才可以離開。
intro_slides.text_en: The dashed line runs through five places and ends at the raft on the shore. Each place holds one game — clear all five to leave the island.

intro_slides.text_zh: 走進叢林盡頭的山洞，讀懂石壁上的壁畫，找出童軍歷史的線索。
intro_slides.text_en: Enter the cave at the end of the jungle, read the paintings on the rock walls, and find the clues to Scouting history.
intro_slides.alt_en: The cave entrance in the jungle

intro_slides.text_zh: 霧中有河，河上無橋。把正確的木板放到橋架上鋪出一條路，再找領袖考核，換取渡河代碼。
intro_slides.text_en: A river runs in the mist, and there is no bridge. Lay the right planks across the frame, then find a leader for the crossing code.

intro_slides.text_zh: 山脊上是一片平地——閱兵場。翻開領袖的《步操手冊》，敬禮、轉法、步法、集隊手號，逐章學會，再找領袖親身考核。
intro_slides.text_en: A flat parade ground waits on the crest. Open the leader's drill manual — the salute, the turns, the paces and the fall-in signs — learn chapter by chapter, then be assessed in person.
intro_slides.alt_en: Pines and cliffs on the ridge

intro_slides.text_zh: 沿溪流走進南面的谷裏，旗桿就立在營地中央。這裡的遊戲也在準備之中。
intro_slides.text_en: Follow the stream down into the southern valley, where the flagpole stands over the camp. Its game is on the way too.
intro_slides.alt_en: The stream, the camp and the flagpole

intro_slides.text_zh: 走上西南面的山崗，崖下就是沙灘——你的木筏正在那裏等你。
intro_slides.text_en: Climb the seaward bluff in the south-west; the beach is right below — your raft is waiting there.
intro_slides.alt_en: The beach and the raft below the bluff

intro_slides.text_zh: 五個遊戲全部完成，你就考獲會員章，可以乘木筏離開荒島。現在，從第 1 站出發！
intro_slides.text_en: Clear all five games to earn the Membership Badge and sail away on the raft. Now — set off for stop 1!
